ui_bugs.issue: The 12-hour rain metric renders with data-testid='health-metric-rain-h-' instead of the spec's 'health-metric-rain-12h'. Root cause: `k.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '-')` strips the digits '12' from label 'Rain (12h)'. Fix: replace regex with `/[^a-z0-9]+/g` (and trim trailing dashes) or hardcode key='rain-12h'. Value itself is correct (e.g. '14%').

issues: After switching to Mumbai, the string 'Rajahmundry' still appears in the visible body inside the saved-place chip (saved-place-rajahmundry). This is expected saved-locations behaviour, but the review request literally asked 'No stale Rajahmundry remains anywhere in the visible body'. Consider either updating the acceptance criterion or hiding non-selected saved chips.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only outstanding issue is the health-metric-rain-12h test-id slug bug in App.js HealthCard (regex strips digits). Once fixed, re-run the same Playwright flow. Backend is stable; iteration_8 pytest suite still fully passes and covers the enriched shape.
rca of the issue: In App.js HealthCard, the data-testid for each metric row is generated by `k.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '-')`. For label 'Rain (12h)' this collapses ' (12', ')' into single '-'s AND strips the digits because `[^a-z]` matches any non-letter (including 0-9). Output becomes 'rain-h-' → data-testid 'health-metric-rain-h-'. Fix: use `/[^a-z0-9]+/g` and optionally `.replace(/-+$/,'')` so 'Rain (12h)' → 'rain-12h' → 'health-metric-rain-12h' as the review request expects.
